orientation.basis: The title, two body lines, and footer read left-to-right in a vertically ordered portrait layout.

blindPixelObservations: A portrait-format illustrated rules card fills the image.
The upper artwork uses black, dark blue, violet, cyan, pink, and red; an armed figure moves through a chain-filled industrial corridor.
One standalone white-and-red crossed pictogram appears near the upper-right corner of the artwork.
A magenta-and-black title frame overlays the lower edge of the artwork.
Below the title are two centered instruction lines; the first line contains one solid white polygonal pictogram.
The footer is black with widely spaced magenta letters.
